jobs.title: AI & IT Systems Lead
jobs.summary: Cilj pozicije je da uspostavi i vodi primenu Claude AI platforme preko postojećih ERP CRM i ecommerce sistema kako bi se izvukla praktična dnevna vrednost za prodaju operacije finansije i marketing. Kandidat će biti vlasnik IT okvira na strani kompanije, koordinisati spoljne partnere i podizati usvajanje kroz obuke i merenje rezultata.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu WHO WE ARE The End of Line (TEOL) is a B2B distributor of packaging and palletizing materials and equipment, operating on the market since 2007. We operate in Serbia, Croatia, and Bosnia & Herzegovina with a team of 27 employees. We run on SAP Business One, Salesforce, Magento 2, and Microsoft 365. We have decided that Claude (Anthropic) will be the AI platform on top of all of them and part of how every colleague works. We are looking for the person who will make that happen. THE ROLE You will be responsible for the proper operation and development of TEOL’s IT infrastructure and, above all, for implementing Claude across the organization. You will report directly to the General Manager. Technical administration of SAP Business One, Microsoft 365, Magento 2, and Salesforce is handled by our external partners. You are the owner on our side. You understand how these systems work and how they connect, you decide what we need, and you make sure the partner delivers. Your main job is to make AI work on top of them and to bring the whole team along. WHAT YOU WILL DO Own the IT landscape (SAP Business One, Microsoft 365, Magento 2, Salesforce) on our side: set priorities, brief and manage the external partner, and check quality, deadlines, and costs. Lead the roll-out of Claude as our main AI platform: set-up, access, governance, rules for the safe use of company data, and phased adoption by the team. Connect AI with our platforms and data, so that sales, operations, finance, and marketing get real, daily value from it. Train and coach colleagues in Serbia, Croatia, and Bosnia & Herzegovina, and help them build prompts, workflows, and templates for their own work. Collect needs from colleagues, turn them into clear requirements, and prioritize them with the General Manager. Measure adoption and results, and keep improving. Be the first point of contact for IT and AI questions. Reference: o8Y6d69prxPFngWJNO3BsqGwMnaG_LjKRfL2qc5UihAjSAHTDkalnTuooQlDNTBN WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 2–4 years of experience in IT, business systems (ERP/CRM/e-commerce), or digital projects, with strong potential to grow quickly. Solid understanding of how business systems work (ERP, CRM, e-commerce, collaboration tools) and how they exchange data. Deep expertise in any one of them is not required. Real hands-on experience with generative AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) and a clear view of how it can run on top of company systems. A natural ability to teach: you explain technology simply and patiently to non-technical colleagues, and you like helping others improve. Good organization and the ability to manage a third-party supplier. Fluent Serbian and English, written and spoken, are required. A degree in IT, engineering, economics, or equivalent practical experience. ADVANTAGES Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, automation, or API integrations. Basic knowledge of data protection and information security (GDPR). Experience in introducing new tools or ways of working in a team. WHAT WE OFFER A competitive salary and a performance bonus. A training budget for your own development. Hybrid work: 3 days in our Belgrade office, 2 days from home. Direct access to the General Manager and real influence in a mid-sized company where decisions are made quickly. The chance to lead one of the most important changes in the company, with full ownership. HOW TO APPLY Send your CV and a short note (a few lines) on how you already use AI in your work. All ap

jobs.title: SAP CO Product Costing and CPQ Consultant
jobs.summary: The role exists to design and deliver an integrated product costing and CPQ solution that links SAP S/4HANA with PLM and analytics to enable traceable quotation and lifecycle calculations. The successful candidate will establish a scalable global template and ensure consistent end-to-end costing from inquiry through actual cost reconciliation.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Your Mission As SAP CO-Product Costing & CPQ Consultant, you design and implement the future integrated product costing and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solution. You connect SAP S/4HANA product costing with engineering and product data from PLM, quotation processes, lifecycle simulations, and relevant planning and analytics platforms. The objective is a consistent and traceable calculation process from customer inquiry and product design through quotation, product and lifecycle costing, site and manufacturing scenarios, and comparison with actual cost and profitability data in SAP. You combine strong functional knowledge with end-to-end solution delivery responsibility. Core mandate: Establish a scalable CPQ and product costing capability that uses SAP as the source for master and actual data while enabling quotation, simulation, lifecycle views, governance, and global reuse. Key Responsibilities SAP Product Costing and S/4HANA Act as the functional expert for SAP CO-PC and product cost controlling within the ongoing SAP S/4HANA program. Analyze and improve costing structures, costing variants, valuation strategies, overhead calculation, cost component structures, standard costs, and product cost roll-ups. Ensure consistent integration with SAP PP, MM, FI/CO, CO-PA, SD, and relevant master-data processes. Align bills of material, routings, work centers, activity rates, material prices, purchasing data, and overhead logic with the future CPQ architecture. Reference: b8PFA9TRsNEbPdU6VslYV3ttN5JD8B6ZXPCco5HRuauM1ir6mekYDOr-zXJ6bcTW CPQ and Product Lifecycle Costing Translate the existing quotation and calculation logic into a scalable CPQ target solution. Support product, project, assembly, and single-part calculations, including configurable blocks, detailed calculation drivers, machine and process costs, tooling, material, labor, logistics, and overheads. Design lifecycle, variant, and what-if simulations covering annual volumes, price development, ramp-up effects, locations, manufacturing concepts, capacity, investment, margin, and cash impact. Enable target costing, should costing, design-to-cost, quotation costing, and traceable commercial decision-making. Architecture, Data and Integration Design the end-to-end data flow between SAP S/4HANA, PLM/PDM, the CPQ solution, and planning or analytics platforms such as Jedox. Define system boundaries and ownership for engineering data, product structures, commercial assumptions, calculation logic, versions, released values, and actual results. Ensure consistency between engineering BOMs, manufacturing BOMs, routings, purchasing conditions, planning assumptions, standard costs, and actual costs. Specify functional interfaces, mappings, validation rules, error handling, and reconciliation controls. Contribute to solution evaluation and selection without prematurely limiting the target architecture to one specific product. Delivery, Testing and Adoption Lead or support the full delivery lifecycle from requirements and solution design through configuration, build coordination, migration, testing, deployment, and stabilization. Create functional specifications, process designs, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, operating documentation, and training materials. Coordinate external implementation partners and internal SAP, PLM, data, infrastructure, and security teams. Support key users and global sites through structured training, rollout preparation, and post-go-live support. RFQ

jobs.details: Biznis konsultant Biznis konsultant Flaner d.o.o. 2.7 Beograd Beograd: Buleva Mihajla Pupina 115v 20.10.2026. ERP intermediate Mi smo Flaner – od 2014. godine pružamo različite vrste IT usluga sa posebnim fokusom na implementaciju, razvoj, konsalting i održavanje isplativih IT rešenja. U poslovanju koristimo sopstvenu ekspertizu, jaka partnerstva i strateške saveze sa vodećim dobavljačima tehnologija. Raspisujemo konkurs za poziciju Biznis konsultanta , poznavaoca svog posla. Opis posla Analiza poslovnih zahteva i njihovo prevođenje u IT rešenja Analiza i rešavanje problema i korisničkih zahteva Konfiguracija i unapređenje ERP-a Priprema funkcionalnih specifikacija i projektne dokumentacije Učešće u testiranju i puštanju rešenja u produkciju Saradnja sa korisnicima i članovima tima Podrška korisnicima i unapređenje postojećih rešenja Potrebno: Završene osnovne/master studije ekonomskog fakulteta 3-5 godina iskustva u finansijskim poslovima Odlično poznavanje ključnih procesa i razumevanje finansijskih i računovodstvenih procesa Dobre komunikacione veštine i orijentisanost ka korisniku Sposobnost samostalnog rada, ali i timske saradnje Nudimo: Rad na konkretnim i kompleksnim projektima velikih sistema Konkurentnu zaradu u skladu sa znanjem i iskustvom Mogućnost razvoja i usavršavanja Rad u profesionalnom okruženju, sa najboljima u regionu Prijatnu radnu i kolegijalnu atmosferu Dodatno dobrovoljno zdravstveno osiguranje Dodatne dane godišnjeg odmora Besplatan parking Konkuriši Upoznaj kompaniju O Kompaniji Iskustva Plate Mi smo Flaner – mlada kompanija koja posluje u Beogradu, od 2014. godine. Pružamo različite vrste IT usluga visokog kvaliteta, sa posebnim fokusom na implementaciju, razvoj, konsalting i održavanje isplativih IT rešenja. U poslovanju koristimo sosptvenu ekspertizu i strateške saveze sa vodećim dobavljačima tehnologija. Uz potpunu posvećenost svakom projektu i zajednički rad sa klijetnima pri svakom koraku projekta, pokretali smo digitalne transformacije, ubrzavali poslovne procese, ojačavali reputacije, unapređivali efikasnosti i kreirali konkurentne prednosti za njihova poslovanja. Primenjujući efikasne poslovne strategije i jaka partnerstva sa najeminentnijim IT kompanijama, znanje i iskustvo gradili smo kroz veoma uspešne projekte, stičući značajne kompetencije i ujedno gradeći stručni tim. Danas naš stručni tim odlično poznaje poslovne procese u različitim domenima poslovanja i poseduje veliko iskustvo na brojnim SAP projektima. Zato klijentima nudimo svoja rešenja, kao i rešenja zasnovana na svetski priznatim tehnologijama. Na tržištu smo poznati i cenjeni zahvaljujući implementaciji SAP rešenja, pa je i naš trenutni portfolio okrenut ka SAP proizvodima: SAP ISU, SAP ERP i SuccessFactors, kao i pomoć pri licenciranju i kupovini SAP licenci. Jednako uspešno se bavimo i procesima integracije SAP proizvoda sa ostalim non-SAP rešenjima, razvojem sopstvenih rešenja po SaaS modelu, izradom rešenja za određene delatnosti u skladu sa potrebama klijenata, kao i podrškom u IT segmentu u cilju smanjenja troškova. Izgradnja uspešnog tima za nas je mnogo više od pronalaženja grupe ljudi sa pravim miksom profesionalnih veština. Prihvatanjem velikih, kompleksnih projekata, i predanim i stručnim radom na njima, stvorili smo pozitivno radno okruženje u kojem negujemo zajedništvo, poštovanje i profesionalni razvoj. Pratimo potrebe svih članova tima, ulažemo u njihovo znanje i veštine kroz kontinuirane obuke, razmenu znanja i iskusta

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.summary: Senior Frontend and Mobile Developer will design and implement frontend interfaces and a native iOS application for a cloud backed eMobility platform. The role requires close collaboration with frontend backend mobile and UI UX specialists in an agile team to deliver maintainable and scalable user facing software.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu Who are we KEBA Novi Sad is part of the Austrian KEBA Group, a technology company with more than 50 years of experience in industrial automation, energy management, banking automation, e-mobility and logistics. Location & work model This role is based in Novi Sad. We work in a hybrid setup with one guaranteed home office day per week, while additional remote days are possible depending on the project and team needs. Since we are building a new engineering capability from the ground up, we believe close day-to-day collaboration is essential. That's why this is primarily an on-site role. Help us build KEBA's Data Platform KEBA is building an enterprise data platform that will provide the foundation for data, analytics and AI across the entire Group. After developing our first data products, exploring different architectural approaches and building our Data Engineering capability, we are now entering the next phase: turning what we have built into a reliable, secure and scalable platform. For that, we are looking for a Data Platform Engineer (DataOps) . You will work alongside Data Engineers and experienced internal and external experts, taking ownership of the infrastructure, automation and operational foundations that allow our data platform to scale. We are building a platform for the next decade—not for the next sprint. That also shapes the way we work: we value automation, thoughtful engineering, sustainable pace and long-term thinking over constant firefighting. What will you actually do? Your focus will be on making our data platform reliable, repeatable and easy to operate. You will automate deployments, manage cloud infrastructure, establish observability and operational practices, and help Data Engineers deploy and operate their workloads safely and efficiently. This is not a role where you simply operate an established platform. You will help define how DataOps is done at KEBA.
